question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH order_groups AS (
  SELECT
    o.ORDER_ID,
    COALESCE(i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_LINE_COUNT,
    COALESCE(i.ITEM_QUANTITY, 0) AS ITEM_QUANTITY
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE o
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
    ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_2025_ORDERS,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) AS MULTI_LINE_ORDERS,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS MULTI_LINE_ORDER_SHARE,
  AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_UNITS_PER_ONE_LINE_ORDER,
  AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_UNITS_PER_MULTI_LINE_ORDER,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0) AS NO_ITEM_LINE_ORDERS
FROM order_groups
action.metrics: 2025 orders; multi-line order share uses all recorded 2025 orders as denominator; average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line groups; count of orders with no item line

action.answer: Among 4,359,773 recorded orders dated in 2025, 3,052,089 had more than one item line, a share of 0.700057 (70.005686%) of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 for one-line orders and 3.484769 for multi-line orders. Orders with no item line: 0.
